steps.name: Updates and events section
steps.do: Look in Explore for the **Updates and events** heading and tabs.
steps.expect: Either the whole section is hidden (no updates or events for today), or it is visible with **Updates** and/or **Events** tabs.

steps.name: Updates card
steps.do: If **Updates** is available, select it and read the visible card.
steps.expect: The active card shows a type label and a non-blank title. If **Updates** is unavailable or the section is hidden, that is the expected empty outcome for today.

steps.name: Collapse/expand
steps.do: If the section is visible, click the triangle/chevron button beside the **Updates** / **Events** tabs (points down when open, up when collapsed).
steps.expect: The updates/events cards hide when collapsed and return when expanded. If the section was hidden in step 1, that button is not available.

steps.name: Updates carousel
steps.do: If more than one update is loaded, use previous/next update controls.
steps.expect: The visible update card changes. If zero or one update, there is nothing to advance.

steps.name: Events tab
steps.expect: The **Events** tab becomes active. If **Events** is unavailable or the section is hidden, that is the expected empty outcome for today.

steps.name: Events card
steps.do: If an event card is shown, read it.
steps.expect: The active card shows an event name (title) and may include a date range and description. If no event card is shown, that matches the empty outcome above.

steps.name: Change map date
steps.do: On Specific Map, change the date.

steps.name: Updates/Events stay on today
steps.do: Recheck Updates and Events after the map date change.
steps.expect: Updates and Events content is unchanged by the map date (still based on today’s real date).
